alate: The whole body is golden yellow, the postmentum and legs pale, nearly pale yellow. The outline of the head capsule is oval, the vertex slightly arched, the fontanelle dot-like and slightly projecting; in lateral view the postclypeus appears slightly raised and lies below the vertex. Body length 7.46 mm, abdominal width 1.21 mm. Head width including the compound eyes 0.82 mm, excluding the compound eyes 0.76 mm; the projection rate of the compound eye 7 per cent, its long diameter 0.18 mm, its distance from the lower margin of the head 0.12 mm. The diameter of the ocellus 0.06 mm, the ocellus-compound eye distance 0.04 mm, the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket greater than that from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Antennae with 13 segments, the specimen broken. Pronotum width 0.62 mm, length 0.46 mm, the median line faintly discernible, with more than forty long hairs in the middle region.
